name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task states a pure 'never both' restriction, and the hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) clause captures that: key_lost denotes dropping the key while the door is closed, and door_open denotes that the door has been opened. The empty FINAL_STATES is valid because the task imposes no unconditional hard goal.

texts: The agent must never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door at any point during the episode.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0

(u0, !door_open&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, door_open&key_lost) -> u3

(u2, key_lost) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
